fact: A 2019 assessment by the University of Oslo and Universidade Eduardo Mondlane with the Ministry of Health, over one month in six provinces, found that data from health facilities' paper forms were entered into SISMA (DHIS2) at the district health service (SDSMAS), in most districts visited by the statistical officers, and only after a monthly validation done entirely on paper.
title: Reflections, Learnings and Proposed Interventions on Data Validation and Data Use for Action in Health: A Case of Mozambique
publisher: Proceedings of the 1st Virtual Conference on Implications of Information and Digital Technologies for Development (IFIP WG 9.4)
